changelog:
锁屏恢复与发信可靠性修复（1.6.6）

锁屏卡死与启动：修复部分机型锁屏恢复后卡在「加载通知记录」的长时间无界等待（连接隔离、busy_timeout 有界锁、计划内关闭引擎连接、启动页逐步有界步骤）；路由关掉自动切备后只发主通道、失败进重试；传输层异常兜住转 transportError、可恢复失败自动重试一次；runNow 发送前先 cancel debounce Timer 防锁屏恢复重复触发；发送失败弹层加「重试」按钮。历史页：三个 Tab 统一选择态，幻念消息支持直接导出。
changelogEn:
Wake-from-lock & send reliability (1.6.6)

Splash-screen hang & startup: fixed the long unbounded wait stuck on "loading notification record" after waking from lock on some devices (connection isolation, bounded busy_timeout for lock contention, planned engine-connection closes, per-step splash budget with timeout); routing no longer touches fallback channels after failover toggle removal, failed deliveries retry on primary only; transport-layer exceptions caught and translated to transportError with one automatic retry; runNow cancels the previous debounce timer before sending to prevent duplicate triggers; the transportError dialog on failed sends now has a Retry button. History page: unified selection mode across all three tabs, Fnthink messages can be exported directly.
